'''Wellington Beck''' is an [[Engineers|Odyssey Engineer]] based at '''Beck Facility''' in the '''Jolapa''' system. A gifted scientist with several advanced degrees, he worked briefly for Sirius Corporation before establishing an independent workshop.<ref name="edwiki-beck">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Wellington_Beck Wellington Beck], Elite Dangerous Wiki; in-game biography and legacy service record. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

Beck specialises in suit utility and battery modifications together with range and optic modifications for handheld weapons.<ref name="inara-beck">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/30/ Wellington Beck — Engineer], INARA; current access, referral, and modification record. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

Beck Facility is a surface Engineer base on Jolapa 6 a, approximately 2,133 Ls from the system arrival point.<ref name="inara-beck-facility">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/275264/ Beck Facility — Station], INARA; current facility and location record. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Access requirements ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Stage
! Requirement
|-
| Discovery
| Receive a referral from [[Hero Ferrari]] after providing her with '''5 Settlement Defence Plans'''.
|-
| Unlock
| Sell a combined total of '''15 Multimedia Entertainment, Classic Entertainment, and Cat Media''' to bartenders.
|}

Any combination of the three qualifying media types counts toward the same total. They are Odyssey Data rather than physical cargo. Their acquisition and the complete bartender-sales workflow belong to [[Unlocking Wellington Beck]].<ref name="inara-beck" />

Frontier's Update 18.08 established the current 15-item combined requirement and reduced Ferrari's referral requirement from 15 Settlement Defence Plans to 5.<ref name="frontier-1808">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-0-18-08 Type-8 Update Release Notes (18.08)], Frontier Developments; revised Odyssey Engineer requirements. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

{{Field note|INARA reports that station services may not appear immediately after the workshop is unlocked. Relogging should make them available.<ref name="inara-beck" />}}

== Odyssey Engineering ==

Beck installs individual modifications into available suit and handheld-weapon modification slots. His services do not use the Grade 1–5 Engineer-reputation progression, blueprint rolls, Experimental Effects, or Remote Engineering used for ship modules. Equipment grade and modification-slot availability are handled through the wider [[Odyssey Engineering]] system.

== Engineering services ==

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Modification
! Equipment
! Purpose
|-
| Extra Backpack Capacity
| Suit
| Increases the suit backpack's Data, Component, and Item capacity.
|-
| Improved Battery Capacity
| Suit
| Increases the suit battery's energy capacity.
|-
| Reduced Tool Battery Consumption
| Suit
| Reduces energy consumption from applicable suit-tool functions.
|-
| Greater Range
| Handheld weapon
| Increases effective weapon range; recipes differ by manufacturer.
|-
| Scope
| Handheld weapon
| Adds a scope or improves an existing optic.
|}

These five modification types are available once Beck is unlocked, subject to compatible equipment, an open modification slot, and the required Odyssey materials and credits.<ref name="inara-beck" /> Their complete recipes and cross-Engineer availability belong to [[Odyssey Engineer Modifications]].

== Direct referral ==

Beck provides the referral to [[Uma Laszlo]]. After unlocking his workshop, deliver '''5 Insight Entertainment Suites''' to Beck to receive that referral.<ref name="inara-beck" /><ref name="inara-uma">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/32/ Uma Laszlo — Engineer], INARA; current reverse referral relationship. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

<pre>
Wellington Beck
└── Uma Laszlo
</pre>

Insight Entertainment Suites are Odyssey Goods, unlike the three Data types sold to unlock Beck. Acquisition methods belong to the material's reference and unlock-procedure coverage.
